$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F03 hero (H), front on and close, landscape: the photographer's width is kept, at 3:2. The right temple's outer face shows end-on at the far left: its old print comes off (rebuilt along the face, which converges hard toward the back) and the GCD goes on as the temple's angle shows it, a narrow sliver near the hinge. It is placed with the old print as a ruler (its ends 23.7 and 38.4 mm from the hinge, from the 3D model on IMG_3495). The temple starts where its face meets the end-piece's narrow side, about 7 mm short of the front's edge: the first placement had taken that edge for the hinge and put the GCD on the end-piece. The striped light panel mirrored in the right lens goes; the far temple seen through the left lens stays. By the bridge the image-left lens turns into its bevel along a dark line that the dust clean-up took for dust inside SAM's mask and left past it, ragged: it is kept (lens_cleanup.keep). At the image-right lens's corner by the bridge SAM stopped up to 20 px short of the lens, where the far temple seen through it runs into the rim: the corner is added by hand (lenses.add), along the edge as measured row by row and column by column; left out, the lens there was taken for a pale strip of frame. alt A2: the hero is turned like F02's (the far lens about 0.84 the width of the near one), so its alt text says three-quarter view, not front view.

marks.name: old print and emblem on the right temple's face, end-on (inset from its edges)
